questions.question: What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘–’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged? 6408 × 8 + 27 –15 ÷ 10 = ?
questions.questionHtml:
What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘–’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?
6408 × 8 + 27 –15 ÷ 10 = ?
questions.solution:
Given equation: 6408 × 8 + 27 –15 ÷ 10 = ?

After interchanging the signs then:

⇒ 6408 ÷ 8 - 27 + 15 × 10 = ? ⇒ 801 - 27 + 15 × 10 ⇒  801 - 27 + 150 
⇒ 951 - 27 = 924

questions.question: Three Statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. Statements: All peas are vegetables. All carrots are vegetables. All vegetables are greens. Conclusions: I. All peas are greens. II. All greens are carrots. III. Some greens are peas.
questions.questionHtml:
Three Statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if
they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the
statements.
Statements:
All peas are vegetables.
All carrots are vegetables.
All vegetables are greens.
Conclusions:
I. All peas are greens.
II. All greens are carrots.
III. Some greens are peas.

options.text: Both conclusions I and III follow.

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follow.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
Conclusions:

I. All peas are greens. - True (because All peas are vegetables and All vegetables are greens. So, All peas are greens too)

II. All greens are carrots. - False (because All carrots are vegetables and All vegetables are greens. So, All greens are carrots it is not definite)

III. Some greens are peas. - True (because All peas are vegetables and All vegetables are greens. So, Some greens are peas too)

questions.question: Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. Statements: All crows are parrots. All eagles are parrots. All parrots are birds. Conclusions: I. No crow is a bird. II. Some birds are eagles. III. All birds are crows.
questions.questionHtml:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if
they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All crows are parrots.
All eagles are parrots.
All parrots are birds.

Conclusions:

I. No crow is a bird.
II. Some birds are eagles.
III. All birds are crows.

options.text: Either conclusion II or III follows
options.html: Either conclusion II or III follows

options.text: Both conclusions I and III follow.
options.html: Both conclusions I and III follow.

questions.solution:
Conclusions:

I. No crow is a bird. - False (because All crows are parrots and All parrots are birds. So, it can not be possible)

II. Some birds are eagles - This is True because all eagles are parrots, and all parrots are birds.

III. All birds are crows - This is False because there are birds that are parrots but not crows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Only conclusion II follows".

questions.question: In a certain code language, X + Y means ‘X is the sister of Y’, X − Y means ‘X is the son of Y’, X × Y means ‘X is the husband of Y’, X ÷ Y means ‘X is the mother of Y’. Based on the above, how is T related to X if ‘T + U − V × W ÷ X’?
questions.questionHtml:
In a certain code language,
X + Y means ‘X is the sister of Y’,
X − Y means ‘X is the son of Y’,
X × Y means ‘X is the husband of Y’,
X ÷ Y means ‘X is the mother of Y’.
Based on the above, how is T related to X if ‘T + U − V × W ÷ X’?
questions.solution:
T is the sister of U, U is the son of V, V is the husband of W and W is the mother of X.

​

So, T is the 'Sister' of X.

questions.question: What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation if '+' and '−' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged? 15 − 7 ÷ 4 + 36 × 9 = ?
questions.questionHtml:
What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation if '+' and '−' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged?
15 − 7 ÷ 4 + 36 × 9 = ?
questions.solution:
Given equation: 15 − 7 ÷ 4 + 36 × 9 = ?

After interchanging the signs then:

⇒ 15 + 7 × 4 - 36 ÷  9 = ? ⇒  15 + 7 × 4 - 4 ⇒  15 + 28 - 4
⇒  43 - 4 = 39
